# Getting help

- **How do I…?** Ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/cloudfall-dev/cloudfall/discussions) under Q&A
- **Something is broken.** Open a [bug report](https://github.com/cloudfall-dev/cloudfall/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with the command, the JSON Cloudfall printed and its exit code
- **Moving off a PaaS?** Open a [pilot request](https://github.com/cloudfall-dev/cloudfall/issues/new?template=pilot.yml)
- **A security issue.** Report it privately as described in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

Start with the [getting started guide](../docs/getting-started.md) and the [proving runs](../docs/proving-runs/): most questions about what Cloudfall does on a real server are answered there.
